The '''Enviro-Tent 30C''' was a model of [[pressure tent]] manufactured by [[TasCorp]]. Large in size, the 30C was equipped with a [[gas regulator]] and used four vehicle [[oxygen tank]]s to maintain the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The tent could sustain a maximum of forty individuals for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="J15" />
